page.overview:
What is Banora Underground?

Banora Underground is the final dungeon of Crisis Core -Final Fantasy VII- and a secret network of caves underneath the town of Banora. The caves are mazes of naturally made caverns and waterways, the ruins of Shinra Electric Power Company's laboratories and private prison facility, and an area with a statue of a woman holding the Goddess Materia.

The Banora Underground is home to the most powerful enemies in the regular game of Crisis Core -Final Fantasy VII- and once the player enters they cannot leave save for missions. To unlock the door to the final battles, the player must find seven special Materia, called the Goddess Materia: Light Materia, Star Materia, Heaven Materia, Ground Materia, Life Materia, Sabbath Materia, and Being Materia, that are scattered throughout the dungeon.

The Banora Underground was one of many sites examined by the Shinra Electric Power Company for the potential to host a mako reactor. The underground mines were built with this purpose in mind, but the site was closed when Shinra discovered a Weapon in stasis, and the village of Banora was built to hide the discovery with Shinra staffing it with residents.

Shinra employees were placed on the village board of trustees but eventually the company lost interest in the site and Banora became a free village. After his role in Project G concluded, Genesis Rhapsodos was sent to live in Banora under foster parents, as were Gillian and Angeal Hewley and others involved in the project, to live under surveillance. Genesis discovered the abandoned caverns by chance and made his secret headquarters there, which Zack Fair will discover years later and read Genesis's childhood diary.
